items.reason: A gentle-strength retinol is a sensible starting point for softening the look of fine lines.
Retinol makes skin more sun-sensitive, so a mineral SPF 50 each morning is a good match for fair, sensitive-feeling skin.
A light ceramide moisturizer helps keep skin feeling comfortable while it adjusts to retinol.

response.routine_note: Start by using the retinol 2 nights a week after cleansing, adding a night only as your skin feels comfortable, and follow with moisturizer. Apply the SPF every morning and avoid layering other exfoliating products with it at first.
